value.rationale: Site of irreversible capture is a natural geometric control variable; center and peripheral sites are inequivalent vertex orbits. The exact peripheral result exposes a mixed dephasing/trap rate and a previously non-implied m^(3/2) optimized network-size law despite free optimization of both noise and sink strength. This supplies a concrete, predictive solvable benchmark for transport-device design, not a renamed textbook deduction. Requires no general network theorem.
